Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Principal Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Principal Officers Appointment of Todd C. Fowler to the Board of Directors On October 29, 2026, the Company announced that its board of directors (the “Board”) expanded its size from ten to eleven directors and appointed Mr. Todd C. Fowler to fill the new director position, effective immediately. Mr. Fowler will serve as a director until the 2027 annual meeting of stockholders, except in the event of his earlier death, resignation or removal. Mr. Fowler has been appointed by the Board to serve as a member of the Audit Committee. In connection with his appointment, the Board determined that Mr. Fowler is independent within the meaning of the Nasdaq Global Select Market listing standards and Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) regulations. Mr. Fowler will be entitled to receive the same annual compensation as other non-employee directors of the Company as described in the Company’s most recent proxy statement, filed with the SEC on March 16, 2026, on a pro-rated basis. In addition, the Company enters into customary indemnification agreements with its directors, the form of which was filed with the SEC as Exhibit 10.2 with the Company’s Form 8-K filed on December 13, 2006. There are no transactions to which the Company or any of its subsidiaries is a party and in which Mr. Fowler has a direct or indirect material interest subject to disclosure under Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K. There are no arrangements or understandings between Mr. Fowler and any other persons pursuant to which he was appointed to the Board. Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosures A copy of the press release announcing the appointment of Mr. Fowler to the Board is furnished hereto as Exhibit 99.2 to this Report on Form 8-K. Item 8.01 Other Events On October 29, 2026, the Company also announced that the Board approved a stock repurchase program authorizing the Company to repurchase up to $250 million of outstanding common stock. The program is effective immediately and permits shares of common stock to be repurchased from time to time at management’s discretion through a variety of methods, including a 10b5-1 trading plan, open market purchases, privately negotiated transactions, or other transactions permitted by applicable securities laws and regulations. The timing and amount of repurchases will depend on market conditions and other factors, including business conditions, alternative investment opportunities, funding considerations, and other matters considered relevant by management and the Board. The stock repurchase program has no expiration date, does not obligate the Company to acquire a specified number of shares, and may be suspended, modified or terminated by the Company at any time, without prior notice.
